scripts.vercel-build: if [ ! -f public/flutter_bootstrap.js ]; then FLUTTER_SDK="$(mktemp -d)" && git clone --depth 1 --branch stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$FLUTTER_SDK" && (cd ../frontend && "$FLUTTER_SDK/bin/flutter" build web --release --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=/api) && mkdir -p public && cp -R ../frontend/build/web/. public/; fi
